candidates.description: This feature vector activates on Hindi conditional, temporal, and interrogative conjunctions and pronouns.
This feature vector activates on subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Hindi script.
This vector is related to consonant-vowel combinations and character sequences in Indic scripts, specifically Devanagari.
These tokens represent common Hindi punctuation marks and vowel-sign combinations that frequently appear as sentence endings.
This vector represents Hindi character and sub-word tokens.
This vector represents the Hindi vowel sign matra 'aa' (ा) combined with various consonant characters.
This vector activates for common Hindi verb inflections and grammatical suffixes indicating tense, aspect, and gender agreement.
This vector is related to character n-grams, subword units, and phonetic components from the Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates on character fragments and subword components from Hindi text.
This vector activates common Hindi vowel matras and consonant-vowel combinations used in phonetic subword tokenization.
